tweets.text:
Unpopular opinion:

Quantum threat is bearish for ZEC. Its imminence will force BTC hodlers to take proactive measures toward quantum-resistant solutions within 24 months. People underestimate hodlers' desire and willingness to make this happen due to their vested interests. It will arrive sooner than most expect.

Then ZEC’s quantum-resistant edge will be gone.

For now you may ZODL. But don’t fool yourself thinking there’s a second-best crypto commodity. BTC will win.
